risk_title: Assistant quotes an out-of-date tariff or balance
description: Answers may use old prices or stale account data, leading to complaints and wrongly set expectations
treatment_actions: Answer only from the live tariff service; refuse to answer if the feed is more than 24 hours old; weekly transcript sampling

risk_title: Customer in vulnerable circumstances is not handed to a person
description: The assistant may miss signs that a customer needs a person, or ignore a priority services flag
treatment_actions: Priority services flag always routes to staff; keyword triggers for distress and debt; monthly review of conversations that should have been handed over

risk_title: Customers are not told they are talking to AI
description: The chat window might not make clear that the assistant is automated
treatment_actions: Banner and first message identify the assistant as AI; tested in the app and on the website

risk_title: Chat transcripts hold card or bank details
description: Customers may type payment details into the chat and the supplier may store them
treatment_actions: Mask card and bank numbers before storage; cap supplier retention at 30 days in the data processing agreement

risk_title: Supplier changes the model without notice
description: A silent model change could alter answers or break handover rules
treatment_actions: Add a 30 day change-notice clause to the contract; rerun the regression question set on every notified change

risk_title: Call summaries include payment card details
description: Card numbers read out during a call may appear in the summary and be saved to the account note
treatment_actions: Pause recording and transcription during payment; redaction rule on summaries; delete affected notes

risk_title: Agents save summaries without checking them
description: A wrong summary could record a promise or a complaint incorrectly
treatment_actions: Agent must confirm the summary before saving; monthly quality sample of 50 calls

risk_title: Complaint urgency is scored lower for some customer groups
description: The model may rank complaints from some groups lower than similar complaints from others
treatment_actions: Test on historical complaints by group before widening the pilot; quarterly fairness check; handlers can always raise urgency

risk_title: Handlers rely on the triage label without reading the complaint
description: A confident label may lead staff to skip reading, so a serious complaint waits
treatment_actions: Show the reason and confidence for each label; handler must confirm the band; sample reviews of low bands

risk_title: Model infers health or personal circumstances from contact patterns
description: Inferences about a customer's health or situation could be wrong, intrusive or hard to explain
treatment_actions: Do not build until classification, the data protection impact assessment and legal review are done; consider simple rules based on information customers gave us

risk_title: A flag wrongly withholds priority help from a customer who needs it
description: A missed flag may mean a customer does not get support they are entitled to
treatment_actions: Treat the model only as an addition to existing routes into priority services; never use it to remove support; test against known cases
